## Area

Client render / simulation tick / networking / persistence / other:

## Measurement

What did you measure, and how? Include numbers (frame time, tick time, bandwidth, memory).

## Problem

Where is the bottleneck, and what is its impact?

## Proposed Optimization

The change, and why it should help.

## Validation Plan

How will the improvement be verified (benchmark, load test)?
